dev_email_cn:
尊敬的 Mary 总监,

您好! 我是 [Your Company] 的张华, 我们是 API 610 认证的工业水泵专业制造商, 在中国/越南均有工厂. 注意到 Acme Industrial Pumps 在北美工业水泵领域是公认的标杆品牌, 年进口额约 $12M.

我们最近为 3 家美国 Tier-1 客户在 8413.70 系列上实现了 12-18% 的成本优化, 同时保持 API 610 标准. 想与您探讨在不影响 Acme 现有质保政策前提下, 联合优化采购成本的可能性.

附件是 3 套定制报价对比 + 客户案例. 是否方便本周三或周四 30 分钟视频会议?

期待您的回复.

此致
张华 | Senior Account Manager
dev_email_en:
Dear Ms. Johnson,

Greetings from [Your Company]! I am Hua Zhang, working with an API 610 certified industrial pump manufacturer with facilities in China and Vietnam. We have noted that Acme Industrial Pumps is a recognized leader in North American industrial pumps, with annual imports around $12M.

We recently helped 3 US Tier-1 customers achieve 12-18% cost optimization on HS 8413.70 series pumps while maintaining API 610 standards. We would love to explore whether we can support Acme in optimizing procurement costs without affecting your current 5-year warranty commitment.

Attached please find: (1) 3 customized quotation comparisons; (2) US client case studies. Would Wed or Thu this week work for a 30-minute video call?

Looking forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Hua Zhang | Senior Account Manager
